note: The private half of tests/data/mapmaker_rules_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the rules word that a NEW Extended map gets (docs/MAP_EDITOR.md, E4): the rule and its line at 90 rows (mapmaker_sizes.js), the Resize that gives the word in the step of the new size (mapmaker_blocks.js), Copy and Start an Extended map (the core's copy with long orders, the plain copy, the open map never touched: mapmaker_convert.js), the places that make a new map and the places that must not (mapmaker_app.js: New map, Save as a new map, Download, Open), the Rules 2 badge (the page, its style, the cards and the lists), the words of the Classic map made from a map of long orders, the Undo of a Resize that changed a word, the New map that is never lost to a core that cannot give the copy, and the page that is told to reload when its wrapper and its module are both old. Run: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/mapmaker_rules_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 (do not commit the .report.json). Each must fail the page's node checks or its wiring tests; the last one needs build_web/lvl_core.
